name: balances-lib
description: Wallet balance math lives in pure src/lib/balances.js (deriveBalances, monthTotals), reused by Wallet and Insights
body: src/lib/balances.js holds the wallet's money derivation as pure functions: deriveBalances(accounts, transactions) returns {totalOnHand, accountBalances} (totalOnHand = sum openingBalances + net of all signed tx amounts; unassigned tx count toward total but not any account), and monthTotals(transactions, ref=Date.now()) returns {income, expense} for ref's calendar month. Both null-safe. WalletScreen consumes both via useMemo. The Insights screen should reuse these rather than re-deriving. A category-breakdown helper is expected to be added here by the Insights task.
